name: Vowel FOF
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Five very narrow filters sweeping five vowels across five vocal registers, with the formant balance Braids leaves flat. The ancestor of Speech's naive mode, on the same vowel and register grid, carried here at finer resolution.

controls.label: Brightness
controls.description: Tilts the excitation from a dark buzz to a bright breathy hiss.

controls.label: Register
controls.description: Steps the vocal register from bass through tenor to soprano.

controls.label: Vowel
controls.description: Sweeps the vowel through the five phonemes.

controls.label: Formant tilt
controls.description: Restores the formant amplitude balance the stock model leaves flat.
